plan_split:
Official native subagent dispatch (fresh context by default; reviewer / security never fork):
Claude Code: Agent runs subagents in isolated context and returns summaries.
Codex: spawn_agent dispatches parallel subagents (default_subagent_model stays gpt-6.2-sol).
Antigravity: invoke_subagent runs subagents in the background with a clean context.
official_guidance: Official model guidance, thinking levels and API prices:
benchmark_definitions:
$ = Artificial Analysis's cost per index task at API prices, not subscription quota.
CP = index points per US dollar; higher is better. * nothing from this provider reaches 50: its highest.

gemini_usage_body:
Antigravity has no standalone web usage page (gemini.google.com/usage only tracks the Gemini web app). Official ways to view 5h and weekly quotas:
  1. Antigravity App / IDE: open Settings → Models.
  2. Antigravity CLI: run agy -p "/usage" (or enter /usage in interactive mode; this report reads the same source).
